editorial:
Imagine you are dropped right into the middle of a high-stakes security detail at Roppongi Hills. You get to follow Kaoru and his team of Security Police officers as they try to keep a charity event safe. The vibe is tense from the start because Kaoru isn't your average guard; he has a dark past involving terrorists who killed his parents. As the event kicks off, you feel his anxiety grow through sudden headaches and dizziness, making you wonder if a real attack is about to happen. It feels like a ticking time bomb where the heroes are just trying to stay one step ahead of a hidden enemy.

What really works here is how the action blends with the personal drama. The pacing is quick, and the tension keeps you glued to your seat. While some of the plot points feel a bit predictable, the acting makes the danger feel real. If you enjoy thrillers with a bit of emotional weight, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up with a massive confrontation where the true motives of the terrorists are revealed. Kaoru has to face his childhood trauma head-on to stop the attack. After a series of intense fights and clever security moves, the SP team manages to neutralize the threat and save the guests. Kaoru finally finds some peace with his past, realizing that his strength comes from his survival, and the team stands together as heroes.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves high-stakes security thrillers and emotional character arcs.
